messages:
Elena (Finance): Heads up—vendor StrataGrid invoice SG-2026-301 hit an AP hold. Bot says 'PO missing' and unit price doesn't match our SOW. Can AP confirm what's needed? :confused:

Tyler (AP): AP bot: HOLD_REASON=PO_NOT_FOUND + PRICE_MISMATCH. We need either a PO reference on the invoice that matches our PO 5011 or a signed amendment that explicitly sets the new rate. Current invoice shows $0.085/hr vs PO 5011 line at $0.065/hr.

Nora (Vendor Ops): I contacted StrataGrid. They said they updated pricing in their billing portal and sent the invoice automatically—no signed amendment. They claim portal updates are contractually binding per their T&C.

Samir (Procurement): We don't accept unilateral vendor T&Cs as amendments. Any price change needs an executed amendment signed by both parties. If StrataGrid insists, ask them to either reissue at the contracted rate under PO 5011 or provide a signed change order.

billing-bot: Invoice SG-2026-301 uploaded by Nora; status changed to HOLD (PO_NOT_FOUND).

Tyler (AP): If vendor provides an email chain with explicit Procurement approval and cc to Finance we can consider a special-case, but it still needs formal Procurement sign-off to adjust POs. Otherwise AP cannot remit the $ difference.

Elena (Finance): Risk note: paying extra without documentation will break our PO controls and audit trail. We should not shortcut for portal sync issues.

Nora (Vendor Ops): StrataGrid offered two options: 1) reissue invoice referencing PO 5011 at $0.065 for this billing period, or 2) provide a signed amendment for the new $0.085 rate going forward. They asked if we can accept a signed PDF by their CEO via DocuSign.

Samir (Procurement): DocuSign is fine if the signatory is authorized and the amendment references the PO/SOW and effective date. It must not be retroactive for already invoiced periods unless explicitly agreed.

Tyler (AP): For speed, if they reissue under PO 5011 we'll pay the undisputed amount. Any amendment for future pricing must include: "Effective 2026-03-01, SOW #SG-2025 Section 3.2 unit price is amended to $0.085/hr" and both signatures.

Nora (Vendor Ops): Sent vendor request. Also asked them to pause collections while we review.

StrataGrid Billing (via Nora): Vendor replied: "We will reissue at PO rate for current invoice and send DocuSign amendment for future. Attach new invoice in 1 hour"

billing-bot: New invoice SG-2026-301v2 uploaded by Nora; matched to PO 5011 and flagged for AP review.

Tyler (AP): Verified match to PO 5011 and applied early-pay discount per terms. Routing for payment. Closing hold. Ticket AP-8012. :white_check_mark:

Elena (Finance): Thanks. Samir, can we add a vendor note to require signed amendments for portal pricing changes?

Samir (Procurement): Yes—updated vendor master: enforce signed amendment for any rate changes. Also flagged StrataGrid for procurement review.

Nora (Vendor Ops): Closing loop with vendor and asked them to submit amendments before future automated invoices.

Elena (Finance): Resolved. Documenting in AP ticket AP-8012 that payment was for contracted rate only; vendor to provide amendment for future billing.
